summary: Install Ansible for the current user with python3 -m pip install --user ansible, or ansible-core, optionally pinned to a version.
questions: How do I install Ansible with pip without sudo?
How do I pip install a specific ansible-core version?

answer_card.title: Install Ansible with pip
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
python3 -m pip install --user ansible
python3 -m pip install --user ansible-core
python3 -m pip install --user ansible-core==2.12.3
```
